source: nuScenes release supplied in the configured dataset root
publisher_processing: The publisher documents blurring faces and license plates in released nuScenes images.
application_processing: No automatic PII detector is run. Supplemental masks are explicit Engineer annotations on a separate derivative.
display_rule: Require registered source hash, camera calibration, image dimensions and matching policy. Show publisher provenance and individual review state.
export_rule: Require an explicit current Engineer review for each image, a full-size PNG derivative, and a separately approved camera collection revision.
